tonight.headline: Two moves left, and one retraction: keep Lawrence at quarterback.
body: Discount the 76%. KEI returns have only five starters set — no receivers, no defence, no kicker — which is why ESPN shows them at 70.9 against your 119.6. They were editing their lineup Wednesday afternoon, so expect this to move back towards even by Sunday.

Your lineup stands as it is. Yesterday's brief told you to start Stafford over Lawrence; I am withdrawing that. ESPN prefers Stafford by 2.6, but three of four expert boards I read this run rank Lawrence ahead. The two moves worth making are the Team 13 offer and a free Vele-for-Boutte swap, both before Sunday 11:00.

case.label: Why Lawrence stays
case.body: Fantrax ranks Lawrence QB9 and Stafford QB14; WalterFootball projects Lawrence 21 to Stafford's 19; Lindy's calls Lawrence a start and Stafford a sit. SI's Fabiano calls Lawrence a must-start after seven straight games of at least 19.4 points. Only one SI column is firmly on Stafford, citing the Giants' 27th-ranked pass defence.

case.label: What their lineup depends on
case.body: Jaxson Dart and Cam Skattebo both play Monday night at the Rams; De'Von Achane goes to San Francisco, RotoBaller's top-ranked defence this week.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Team 13 accepting the Lamar offer, which puts Jackson at quarterback and makes the Lawrence question moot.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Before Sunday 11:00, Mexico City — Baltimore kick off then
doFirst.title: Send Team 13: Bhayshul Tuten for Lamar Jackson
doFirst.subtitle: Recomputed on this snapshot: +11.6 for you, +40.6 for them, and +3.2 for you this week.

case.label: Their slot column, read today
case.body: Josh Allen starts at slot 0. Lamar Jackson sits at slot 20, scoring nothing in a one-quarterback league. Their weak starter is the second running back, which projects 164.6 for the season behind Christian McCaffrey. Tuten at 205.2 walks straight into that slot.

case.label: What you are buying
case.body: Jackson threw for 324 yards and ran for a score in the 41-23 win at Indianapolis. None of the Wednesday Ravens reports I read list him; the players who missed practice were Zay Flowers (hamstring, day-to-day) and several linemen and pass rushers. His receiving room is thin this week: Flowers is day-to-day and rookie Ja'Kobi Lane is on IR.

case.label: What you are selling
case.body: PFN ranks Tuten RB24 this week, a back in a crowded room: LeQuint Allen was limited Wednesday and may return, and Chris Rodriguez handled the goal line in Week 1. He is also one of three Jaguars on your roster — with Lawrence and Little — who share a Week 7 bye.

case.label: Why this version, not Golden
case.body: Golden for Lamar is +26.5 for you but only +12.2 for them, and Golden is your flex starter after 12 targets in Week 1. Tuten is benched. This version costs you nothing on Sunday and gives them far more reason to say yes.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Jackson appears on Baltimore's Thursday or Friday report; or Team 13 add or start another running back; or they trade or drop a quarterback.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Any time before Sunday 11:00, Mexico City — both players' games kick off then
doFirst.title: Add Devaughn Vele, drop Kayshon Boutte
doFirst.subtitle: A free agent with a real No. 2 receiver role, for your weakest seat. No priority spent.

case.label: The role
case.body: Vele caught 7 of 9 targets for 69 yards and a touchdown in Week 1, played a team-high 82 snaps and ran 58 routes as New Orleans' clear second receiver behind Chris Olave. Rookie Jordyn Tyson is on IR. Tyler Shough threw for 410 yards.

case.label: The anomaly, and why it will close
case.body: He is 46.1% rostered and rising fast (+33), and JuiceJam already claimed him in Chem. Here he is still a free agent, so adding him costs no priority — and IPADE priority never comes back.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Boutte is 13.4% rostered with no analyst rank, and his seat predates the activity log. He was not researched individually this run; the case against him is that he is the one replaceable seat outside the seven-day churn window.

case.label: One wrinkle
case.body: Vele's Week 2 game is at Baltimore, whose defence you start. That only matters if Vele is in your lineup, and he will not be this week.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Vele shows up limited on Thursday's Saints report; or another IPADE manager adds him first, which is the most likely way this card dies.

whatWentWrong.title: The 'start Stafford' card was marked ELITE on a split case
whatWentWrong.lead: It leaned on ESPN's projection and one defence board. Most of today's expert rankings go the other way.

case.label: What the boards say
case.body: Fantrax has Lawrence QB9 and Stafford QB14. WalterFootball projects 21 to 19 for Lawrence. Lindy's lists Stafford as a sit against an improved Giants defence. RotoBaller says Denver's defence struggled in Week 1. Only one SI column backs Stafford firmly.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A Jacksonville injury that limits Lawrence, or a Friday report that rules out Denver's top corners. Then Stafford is the start.

whatWentWrong.sources: Fantrax · WalterFootball · Lindy's Sports · RotoBaller · Sports Illustrated

whatWentWrong.title: The Furia Regia offer did not clear the one-point floor
whatWentWrong.lead: Stafford for McLaurin is +8.7 over the whole season — about half a point a week — and costs you 1.1 this week.

case.label: Why it is withdrawn
case.body: The strategy file says not to propose moves worth under a point. McLaurin also drew only 4 targets in Week 1, and trading Stafford while the Lamar deal is unanswered would leave Lawrence as your only quarterback.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: The Lamar trade landing and McLaurin showing a real target share in Week 2.

case.label: Their slot column, read today
case.body: Allen at slot 0 starting, Jackson at slot 20. Their second running back slot projects 164.6 for the season; Tuten projects 205.2.

case.label: Your side
case.body: On season numbers your best quarterback is Stafford at 286.4, so Jackson at 312.9 is +26.5; losing Tuten drops the season-best flex from his 205.2 to Golden's 190.3, which is -14.9. Net +11.6. On this week's projections it is +3.2.

case.label: The honest risk
case.body: Season projections have not moved since 14 September, so +11.6 is a preseason number. Jackson's top receiver is day-to-day and his rookie receiver is on IR, so Week 2 may be a lean passing week.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Jackson appears on a Ravens injury report this week; Team 13 fill their running back slot; or they move a quarterback.

trades.copyText: Hi — Lamar Jackson is sitting behind Josh Allen and scoring you nothing. I'll send you Bhayshul Tuten for him: Tuten would start at your second RB spot, which is your weakest slot. On season projections that's about +40 for you. Interested?

worthALook.name: Pat Freiermuth
worthALook.lead: The tight end to add if Bowers returns and Mayer's week is over.

case.label: The role
case.body: Freiermuth caught all 5 targets for 46 yards and a touchdown on 73% of snaps, with the third-most routes on the Steelers. Pittsburgh's head coach called him a premier player on Wednesday.

case.label: Why not now
case.body: Bowers missed Wednesday's practice, so Mayer keeps his role this week. IPADE's flex takes a tight end, so a second one only matters when it has a starting role.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Bowers practises fully or plays in Week 2: add Freiermuth as a free agent and drop Mayer.

worthALook.name: T.J. Hockenson
worthALook.lead: The other free tight end with a real role, if you prefer volume to Freiermuth's matchup.

case.label: The role
case.body: 4 catches for 36 yards and a touchdown on 5 targets in Week 1. Minnesota's quarterback is unsettled this week — Kyler Murray limited in the concussion protocol, Carson Wentz otherwise.

case.label: Why not now
case.body: Same reason as Freiermuth: Mayer keeps the tight-end role while Bowers is out.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Bowers returns and Murray is cleared.

doNotChase.name: Josh Allen
doNotChase.lead: The optimiser likes Garrett Wilson for Allen: +16.9 for you, +21.8 for them. Do not send it.

case.label: Why it fails
case.body: It asks Team 13 for the best quarterback in the league while Tuten for Lamar already solves your quarterback slot without touching their starter. On this week's projections the Wilson version also costs you 0.5, and it removes a starting receiver.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Team 13 trading Lamar elsewhere and signalling that Allen is available.
